summary: Independent adversarial review found no blocker or important issues. 180 rows = 30 samples (MCF-7 WT/Y537N/Y537S + SUM44PE WT/LTED-Y537S x E2/EtOH x 3 biological replicates) x 6 SAX fractions; every raw file, fraction and sample assignment matches the deposited MaxQuant experimental design. ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in local OLS cache: UBERON:0000175 pleural effusion, CL:0000066 epithelial cell, MONDO:0005051 invasive lobular breast carcinoma, MONDO:0006256 invasive breast carcinoma, CHEBI:23965 estradiol, CHEBI:16236 ethanol, MS:1002877 Q Exactive HF-X, MS:1000422 beam-type CID, MS:1001251 Trypsin, PRIDE:0000558 SAX, PRIDE:0000608 DTT, PRIDE:0000599 IAA, PRIDE:0000627 DDA, UNIMOD:4/35/1 with correct labels. source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol/dataProcessingProtocol and PMC10959978 Methods: Q-Exactive HF-X, HCD CE 28, DDA top15, trypsin, DTT/IAA, SAX stage-tip fractionation (flow-through + pH 8,6,5,4,3 = 6 fractions), E2 1 nM vs equal-volume EtOH vehicle, 3 biological replicates, CAM fixed, Met oxidation + N-terminal acetylation variable, precursor 4.5 ppm main search. Paper states MCF7 Y537N/Y537S CRISPR clones are heterozygous; PRIDE names SUM44PE-LTED Y537S. Reconcile 'disease_with_control_arm' flag is a false positive: the EtOH arm is a treatment vehicle control, not a healthy control.

file_mapping.evidence: files_compact.json (all URLs under PXD032369) lists 180 RAW files; set-equal to the 180 comment[data file] values, no duplicates; the 18 timestamp-suffixed files have sizes distinct from their un-suffixed namesakes and are mapped to YS_* samples exactly as in experimentalDesignTemplate.ESR1.proteome.txt; non-raw files (txt zip, design, FASTA) correctly excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: Outer merge with deposited design: 180/180 matched, 0 fraction mismatches, 0 sample (Experiment) mismatches after SUM.wt/SUM.LTED -> SUMWT/SUMLTED renaming. Each of 30 source names has fractions 1-6 once; technical replicate 1 throughout. Factors cell line x compound x genotype yield 10 distinct groups of 3 replicates; wild types of the two lines separated by factor value[cell line]; dose 1 nM only on estradiol rows.

omission_safety.evidence: Every characteristic traced to PRIDE, paper, deposited design or Cellosaurus; 'heterozygous' supported by paper Results; SUM44PE age correctly 'not available'; no unsupported ancestry/age values added. Fragment tolerance 20 ppm is the MaxQuant FTMS default consistent with the paper's 'settings left to default' (parameters.txt not staged locally).
